title: Gloria (Morales, Missa Benedicta es)
desc: Cristóbal de Morales, Missa Benedicta es, Gloria, 1551. 4 voices (Cantus, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Mass_0018_2); edited by Vincent Besson, Marco Gurrieri, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
